bullets.text: BritCard's Trust Issues - **BritCard** faces skepticism over its ability to secure public trust amid privacy concerns.
Digital Migration Savings - Urgent migration to digital services could save UK public services over £3 billion by 2040.
Connected Britain Awards 2025 - Celebrating innovation, the **Connected Britain Awards** highlight excellence in the UK digital economy.
Optus Outage Concerns - **Optus** customers faced another outage, raising alarms over emergency service accessibility.
AI Infrastructure Growth - **Deloitte** launches a global AI Infrastructure Center of Excellence to support specialized data centers.
KPN's Satellite IoT Expansion - **KPN** partners with **OQ Technology** to enhance global 5G IoT connectivity using satellite networks.
Huawei's AI Compute Innovations - **Huawei Cloud** unveils advanced AI Compute Service to meet rising demand for AI infrastructure.
MS3 Joins Zen's Fibre Hub - **Zen Internet** partners with **MS3 Networks** to enhance full fibre connectivity in the UK.
Russia's Satellite Surveillance - Concerns rise as **Russia** reportedly stalks NATO satellites, threatening critical communications.
5G Connections Surge - Global **5G** connections hit 2.6 billion, projected to reach nearly 9 billion by 2030.
